title: The mockup format, version 1
description: screens.json, the index of a version of the artifact type mockup: its screens and the links between them. Each screen is one HTML page of the version, named in file. start is the id of a screen in screens; ids are unique; file is the screen's id and .html; each to is the id of a screen; every screen is reachable from start through links; and the to values of a screen are the screens its page links to. A JSON Schema cannot check these, so Qory Apiary checks them beside it. No object has a member this schema does not define.

start.description: The id of the screen shown first.

screens.description: The screens, 1 to 9, in the order a list shows them.

id.description: A screen's id: 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter or a digit.

text.description: Text of 1 to 200 characters with no control character, so none of U+0000 to U+001F, U+007F and U+0080 to U+009F, and no tab or line feed.

screen.description: One screen: its page and where its links lead.

title.description: The screen's title, which the page's <title> has too.

file.description: The page: the screen's id and .html, such as home.html.

criteria.description: The acceptance criteria the screen shows, 0 to 50, each once, such as ac-1.

links.description: The links of the screen, 0 to 100: the screen each leads to and its words.

link.description: One link: to is the id of the screen it leads to, label its words.
